epic.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: central illustration only for an EPIC science-fiction weapon card for Eclissi Stellare, not the full card.
Primary request: a physically buildable futuristic naval STORM CAPACITOR CANNON visibly releasing ONE compact three-dimensional thundercloud projectile. Make it a distinctive industrial capacitor apparatus, not a conventional gun barrel. A horizontal graphite barrel-shaped capacitor bank sits in an asymmetric side-mounted ship bracket with a visible swivel and mechanical mounting flange; two broad curved silver compression ribs frame an open electric chamber. Clear neutral silver cooling fins, ceramic insulators, exposed blue coil windings, grounded conduits, bolted joints, real thickness and purposeful machinery. The side attachment is practical and heavy; no four-legged pedestal.
Show the entire weapon in a consistent three-quarter product-style perspective on a dark space hangar deck, angled from lower left toward upper right. The machine fills roughly the lower-left two-thirds of the illustration, remains fully in frame with generous margins and readable silhouette. Near the upper-right emitter, ONE dense compact volumetric cloud of dark blue ionized mist with a brilliantly branched cyan-white lightning web is separating from the chamber. The cloud is connected visually to the chamber by a short electric wake, approximately one-quarter of the image width. It is a clustered rumbling storm with uneven rounded lobes and internal shadow, not a luminous ball, not an electrical spear, not several shots, not a weather scene. Lightning stays localized within and around this single cloud. Materially modeled smoke volume and crisp electric filaments. Do not cover the machine with particles. Maximum available native detail, cinematic physically based 3D render, hard-surface craftsmanship, high contrast silver and graphite with cool blue electric light, subtle warm metal reflections. Landscape 4:3 composition. NO text, NO border, NO frame, NO card UI, NO icons, NO logo, NO person, NO handheld fantasy staff. No background fleet, no explosions on unrelated objects.
